{{Infobox map |name=Italy |year=2022 |image=Italy_sng_mega_3.jpg |creator=[[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[quaker]] |gametype=4on4 |size=Large |download=https://maps.quakeworld.nu/all/italy.bsp }} Italy (italy.bsp) is a 4on4 Team Deathmatch map created in 2022 by [[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[quaker]].
The original Counter-Strike map is one of five Counter-Strike maps that the mappers of [[The_Wizard's_Manse]] are creating/converting. ===Items=== {{MapItems |quad=1 |ring= |pent=1 |hp100=2 |ra= |ya=1 |ga=1 |lg= |rl=1 |gl=1 |sng=2 |ng= |ssg=2 }} ==Gallery== Italy_GA_2.jpg Italy_GL.jpg Italy_pent_2.jpg Italy_quad_2.jpg Italy_RL_2.jpg Italy_signs_2.jpg Italy_sng_ya.jpg Italy_YA_2.jpg ==Layout== The quakeworld version of Italy stays true to the original but it is smartly cramped down and made 30-40% smaller. Yet it feels big enough for 4on4 gameplay. The strongest armor on the map (YA) is placed in the "yellow hostage house". Quad at "market" and RL in the open should secure a balanced 4on4 map.

==Strategy & Tactics== As this is an "e1m2 items"-map the tactic seems kind of similar. Keep YA and get Quads and RLs. But there is also a penta and 2 megas on the map and that changes things. ===Download=== You can download the map [https://maps.quakeworld.nu/all/italy.bsp HERE]
